snippet.title: Dice A Million - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Out now on Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3430340/Dice_A_Million/
and Xbox PC GamePass ► https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/dice-a-million/9N3NTDPJCD9Z

Dice A Million is a roguelike deckbuilder about rolling dice to try and get to a million points. That's the whole point. (get it?!)
